hard_gates.gate: G1 tenant isolation, attacked by hand on the real product (API, the app's database role, exports, headers)
hard_gates.evidence: api-attack.txt: admin@alnoor (tenant A) sees 44 sequences and admin@gulfsteel (tenant B) sees 22. No id is in both. A's GET and PUT on B's tax invoice sequence get 404, and B's row is unchanged. The list with B's companyId, tenantId, company-code search and companyCode/companyId filters returns no B rows. The X-Tenant, X-Tenant-Id, X-Company, X-Company-Id, X-Erp-Company and X-Erp-Tenant headers get 404. CSV, PDF and XLSX exports with B's companyId hold no B marker. db-attack-erp_app.txt: as erp_app with tenant A bound, only A's rows are visible (44 sequences, 33 issued numbers, 10 counters). UPDATE and DELETE on B's rows touch 0 rows. INSERT of an issued number for B is refused by RLS. With no tenant bound, or a tenant set without the transaction stamp, 0 rows are visible. This round adds a fix: UPDATE and DELETE on numbering.issued_numbers are now refused to erp_app ('permission denied'; grants erp_app=ar). Numbering has no jobs or file paths.

biggest_gap.title: No full verify passes: in each run one comparison-harness control fails under load, so the round has no green G3
biggest_gap.detail: p10's own code held everywhere I attacked it. Every .NET test passed (971/971), including the G1 HTTP gate that aborted in round 3, which now finishes in 3 h 25 m. e2e, vitest and build tests also passed. The two round-3 holes in the tax repeat check are fixed: switching yearly to monthly with October numbers given, and never to yearly with 2025 numbers given, are both refused with numberingPatternRepeatsNumber. Issued numbers can no longer be changed by the app role. The comparison is a clear win. But the round still needs one full passing ./erp verify, and neither of mine passed. Each run failed a different p01 harness self-test with the same 'page changed what it shows without a counted step' invalidation, which is gate-backlog row 8's class (p01 is frozen). Until that class of control is fixed or an integrator's alone run comes out green, p10 cannot get a clean round. The builder can do nothing in p10 code about it: the fix belongs to p01's backlog row 8, or the integrator's alone run decides.
biggest_gap.evidence: verify-run1-kept/web.log (or verify-critic-p10-numbering-r4.log): 'test at test/set-up-off-clock.test.mjs:131:1 ✖ control C1 ... AssertionError: action outside the clock (set-up) ... StyleRecalcInvalidationTracking ... + invalid - verified'. verify-critic-p10-numbering-r4-run2.log: 'test at test/guard.test.mjs:1228:1 ✖ KLM (round 5) ... ScheduleStyleRecalculation'. Load samples: run 1 peak 75.8 and mean 15.8 (verify-run1-kept/verify-load-samples); run 2 peak 49.3. To reproduce: run ./erp verify through the slot script while another verify runs.

gate_gaps.planted: plant-P2b-only.diff in a separate worktree. A new POST /api/numbering/sequences/{id}/restart guarded by numbering.sequences.read sets every counter of the sequence back to 1. Three reviewed lines are added: endpoint-permissions/numbering.txt (read), read-permission-writes.txt and write-set-unexercised.txt. permission-write-sets.txt still says numbering.sequences.read writes only lists.saved_views.
gate_gaps.evidence: plant-P2b-only-gates.log: 50 G2 tests (G2WriteSet, G2Permission, NumberingWriteSet, G2Subject, G2CompanyRole, G2CompanyWritePolicy) ran and 49 passed. The one failure is G2CompanyRoleTests on the audit trail, which fails the same way without any plant (control-unplanted-companyrole.log). So a read-guarded endpoint that writes counters passes, as long as it is listed as unexercised. read-permission-writes.txt accepts any route, not only list-view saves. Nothing checks a listed unexercised endpoint's writes against permission-write-sets.txt. The real product has no such endpoint.

other_findings: [route: p07-audit] G2CompanyRoleTests.A_role_held_in_company_X_acts_on_nothing_of_company_Y fails on the real, unplanted product when A_manager_of_X_who_reads_Y_is_offered_changes_in_X_alone runs before it in the same fixture. It failed in 3 of 3 runs of the G2CompanyRoleTests class alone, and passed in 6 of 6 runs of the single test and in both full verifies, where it runs first. The failing answer is GET /api/audit/records/{id} = 200, with the insert history of another user's tenancy.user_workplaces row located in company Y (company_id Y, branch 'Alpha Trading branch one', recent_company_ids [Y]). The reader is an administrator of company X alone, who holds tenancy.access.read only in X (diag-companyrole-class-1.log, with the body captured by diag-companyrole-body.diff). Either the audit history lets a permission held in X read a Y record, which is a cross-company read, or the gate's Y classification is wrong. In both cases the gate passes the full suite only because of test order. Not caused by p10.

Repeat check cost: RepeatedNumberAsync now reads every issued number of the company and type that starts with the fixed head of the prefix, in one query, and compares in memory. With 200,000 issued INV numbers inserted on one sequence, PUT took 2.1 to 3.7 s at load 60 to 70 (probe-scale.txt). It is no longer one query per branch, so the round-3 G1 timeout cause is gone, but the cost grows with document history. A company with years of invoices pays it on every pattern change.

Rule 5 holes from round 3 are fixed (probe-rule5.txt). Yearly CN-{YYYY}-{MM}- with CN-2026-10-00001..3 given, then switched to monthly: 400 numberingPatternRepeatsNumber ('could give CN-2026-10-00001 again'). Never CN-{YYYY}- with CN-2025-00001..3 given, then switched to yearly: 400 ('could give CN-2025-00001 again'). Control, digits up to 6: 200.

Rule 2 now holds at the database: erp_app has only SELECT and INSERT on numbering.issued_numbers, and UPDATE and DELETE get 'permission denied' (db-attack-erp_app.txt). The new tests/Gates/append-only-tables.txt is checked against the real grants in both directions, and the G1CompanyScope and G2CompanyWritePolicy checks expect the database's refusal for listed tables. I judged this no weaker than before.

Scope present and working in a real browser: G then N reaches the screen, / searches, Enter opens a row with the prefix focused and selected, and Ctrl+S saves. Enter on the Starts-again select does not save, by design (a list of choices). The live preview shows the next three numbers and the restart date for yearly and monthly. Monthly with {YY}{MM} and other combinations save. Arabic is dir=rtl lang=ar with all labels in Arabic and numbers isolated left to right. No console errors. Counters table and last-numbers list are present.

Seed detail: on the sequence form, the counter's 'Given at' (7:40 AM) is two hours earlier than the same numbers' 'Given at' in 'Last numbers given' (9:40 AM). Rows given at the same moment are listed out of number order (00408, 00409, 00411, 00410).

Processor time for the integrator: run 1 used about 18,984 s (dotnet 15,966, web 2,301, e2e 717), with another verify beside it and peak load 75.8, against the 18,700 maximum now on the integration branch. This is not an alone run.

human_gates.what: p10 enforces the VAT tax-document numbering rules (gapless tax invoices and credit notes, the next number fixed once a number is given, numbers never changed, and a change that could repeat a number refused) from docs/compliance/vat-tax-document-numbering.md.
